Paper Verse:
Centered on the concept of Paper Verse, this project creates an open engineering library that brings reading, research, and exchange together. A concrete base establishes the building’s material character, while vertical curtain-wall fins evoke the texture of turning pages and produce soft, diffused daylight.

The basement contains book storage and a lecture hall for collections and academic events. On the ground floor, an open lobby connects exhibition and training spaces, dissolving conventional boundaries around knowledge. Reading and seminar areas occupy the second and third floors, where double-height voids strengthen spatial continuity. Above, an ETFE-covered sky garden combines a café, sensory gardens, and leisure paths to form a restorative public landscape. Stairs and ramps weave the programs into a continuous sequence in which reading, conversation, and nature coexist, responding to both the campus context and its ecological needs.
